description: Every signal source is adapted into this one handshake schema before it enters the signal loop. Sources earn their place by measured win rate and expectancy — never by promise.

direction.description: Trade direction. New-token launches are long-only in practice.

disarmed_note.description: Ledger flag noting when safety gates were deliberately disarmed for measurement (paper only).

entry.description: Reference entry price in USD at signal time (DexScreener). 0 when the token is too new to be priced.

market.description: Chain the signal applies to, e.g. solana, base

signal_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the signal was emitted.

source.description: Which source produced the signal, e.g. codex, sentinel-aleph, fomotrendings, gmgn_rank

stop.description: Stop-loss price in USD. Conventional frame uses entry * 0.70 (-30%).

take_profit.description: Take-profit price in USD. Conventional frame uses entry * 2.0 (+100%).

token_address.description: On-chain mint/contract address of the token.

title: TradeX-Apex1 normalized signal
